ASUS PRIME H610M-K ARGB LGA 1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard

 The ASUS PRIME H610M-K ARGB Micro-ATX Motherboard is an expertly engineered, high-value foundation designed to unlock the full potential of 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen Intel Core processors. Built around the Intel H610 chipset and LGA 1700 socket, this motherboard combines essential power delivery, ultra-fast PCIe 4.0 expansion, high-speed M.2 NVMe storage support, and customizable Addressable Gen 2 ARGB lighting to deliver rock-solid stability and clean performance for gaming PCs, office workstations, and daily computing setups.

 Meticulously designed for modern micro-ATX PC builds, the ASUS PRIME H610M-K ARGB incorporates ASUS’s signature 5X Protection III hardware safeguards to ensure long-term durability and electrical safety. Featuring comprehensive Fan Xpert cooling controls, Realtek 1Gb Ethernet, HDMI 4K output, and full ASUS Aura Sync ecosystem compatibility, this compact motherboard provides the reliability, expandability, and subtle RGB style needed to construct a dependable desktop system.

 
 
 
 
 Intel LGA 1700 Socket & 14th/13th/12th Gen CPU Support

 Versatile Platform Compatibility for Multi-Core Intel Core Processors

 Engineered around the modern Intel LGA 1700 socket , the ASUS PRIME H610M-K ARGB provides seamless compatibility out of the box for Intel 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors. Whether you are assembling a budget-friendly esports gaming rig or a multi-tasking home office desktop, this motherboard delivers clean energy delivery to keep your processor performing at its peak.

 With refined power circuit design and premium electrical components, the power delivery architecture resists thermal degradation under heavy workloads, ensuring consistent system uptime during extended gaming sessions or intensive productivity tasks.

 
 PCIe 4.0 Expansion & Reinforced SafeSlot Core

 Maximized GPU Bandwidth with Physical Slot Reinforcement

 Prepare your desktop build for modern graphics performance with a primary PCIe 4.0 x16 expansion slot . Offering double the data transfer bandwidth of older PCIe 3.0 standards, this high-speed slot guarantees unhindered communication between your CPU and modern discrete graphics cards.

 To support heavier dedicated GPUs, the expansion slot features ASUS SafeSlot Core structural reinforcement. Anchored securely to the motherboard PCB with a specialized retention hook, SafeSlot Core provides superior slot retention and shearing resistance to protect your components from accidental damage.

 
 Ultrafast 32Gbps M.2 NVMe Storage & SATA Interfaces

 Rapid System Boot Speeds paired with Flexible Storage Expansion

 Say goodbye to slow system boot times and lagging application launches. The PRIME H610M-K ARGB features an integrated PCIe 3.0 x4 M.2 slot capable of delivering data transfer speeds up to 32Gbps, making it the perfect home for high-performance NVMe solid-state drives.

 Complementing the M.2 slot are four SATA 6Gb/s ports for traditional hard drives and 2.5-inch SSDs, giving system builders generous storage flexibility for expanding game libraries, media archives, and project files.

 
 Onboard Addressable Gen 2 Headers & Aura Sync ARGB

 Customizable Lighting Ambiance Controlled via Armoury Crate

 Elevate your desktop’s visual presentation with built-in Addressable Gen 2 ARGB headers . Designed to automatically detect the LED count on connected addressable RGB strips and chassis fans, these headers allow for fine-tuned, dynamic lighting effects across your setup.

 Through ASUS Aura Sync software in Armoury Crate, users can easily synchronize lighting patterns across supported ARGB fans, CPU coolers, mechanical keyboards, and gaming mice to create a clean, unified lighting theme.

 The GIGABYTE H610M K V2 DDR5 Micro-ATX Motherboard is an accessible, high-efficiency foundation engineered to bring next-generation DDR5 memory bandwidth and reliable computing performance to 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen Intel® Core™ processors. Built on the Intel H610 chipset and Socket LGA 1700, this compact motherboard combines essential digital power delivery, PCIe 4.0 expansion, high-speed NVMe M.2 storage support, and essential system cooling controls to deliver solid daily stability for budget-conscious gaming builds and office workstations.

 Meticulously designed for modern micro-ATX desktop configurations, the GIGABYTE H610M K V2 DDR5 incorporates GIGABYTE’s signature Anti-Sulfur resistor design and Smart Fan 6 thermal management to protect internal circuits and maintain quiet acoustics under light and heavy loads alike. Featuring Realtek Gigabit LAN with bandwidth management, dual digital video outputs (HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.2), and high-quality audio capacitors with an audio noise guard, this motherboard provides the ideal mix of affordability, speed, and durability.

 Versatile Platform Compatibility for Multi-Core Intel Processors

 Engineered around the modern Intel LGA 1700 socket , the GIGABYTE H610M K V2 DDR5 provides seamless compatibility out of the box for Intel 14th, 13th, and 12th Generation Core, Pentium Gold, and Celeron processors. Whether you are assembling an entry-level esports gaming PC or a multi-tasking home office desktop, this motherboard delivers clean, regulated power to keep your processor running smoothly.

 With refined power circuit routing and solid electrical components, the power delivery system resists thermal degradation during extended computing tasks, ensuring consistent system uptime.

 
 Next-Gen Dual-Channel DDR5 Memory Architecture

 High-Bandwidth Performance Supporting Speeds Up to 5600 MT/s

 Step into the future of system responsiveness with support for high-speed DDR5 memory modules across 2 DIMM slots , supporting up to 128GB of total system RAM. DDR5 delivers significantly higher data transfer rates and lower operating voltages compared to previous-generation DDR4 memory.

 With full support for Intel® Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) profiles, users can easily activate pre-tuned memory frequency and timing profiles in BIOS to achieve improved multi-tasking and faster system boot times.

 Maximized GPU Bandwidth paired with 32Gbps M.2 Data Transfer Speeds

 Prepare your system for modern graphics performance with a primary PCIe 4.0 x16 expansion slot . Offering double the bandwidth of older PCIe 3.0 standards, this slot ensures unhindered throughput for modern discrete graphics cards.

 For fast application loading and rapid file transfers, the motherboard houses an integrated PCIe 3.0 x4 M.2 slot supporting up to 32Gbps transfer speeds for NVMe solid-state drives, complemented by SATA 6Gb/s ports for traditional storage drives.

 
 Realtek GbE LAN & Dual 4K Digital Display Connectivity

 Low-Latency Networking paired with HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.2 Outputs

 Enjoy reliable, stable internet connectivity with the onboard Realtek Gigabit LAN controller equipped with bandwidth management software to prioritize critical network traffic for smooth online browsing and gaming.

 The GIGABYTE B760M H mATX Gaming Motherboard is designed to support Intel’s 13th and 12th Gen processors, making it a solid choice for gamers and professionals seeking performance in a compact design. With DDR4 memory support, PCIe 4.0 for graphics, and dual M.2 slots for high-speed storage, this motherboard provides the essential features for a powerful, streamlined build. The B760M H’s efficient mATX form factor allows for flexibility in case compatibility while delivering stable performance.

 Key Features of the GIGABYTE B760M H Motherboard

 
• Intel 13th and 12th Gen Processor Compatibility – Supports Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold, and Celeron® processors

• Compact mATX Form Factor – Space-saving design with extensive compatibility for smaller cases

 Efficient Performance with DDR4 and PCIe 4.0

 With DDR4 memory support up to 3200MHz and a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot, the GIGABYTE B760M H delivers smooth and reliable performance for gaming, multitasking, and professional applications. Its dual-channel memory architecture and support for XMP memory modules ensure that users can easily optimize system performance for demanding tasks.

 

 High-Speed Connectivity and Expansion Options

 This motherboard includes a variety of I/O options, such as USB 3.2 Gen 1 ports, HDMI, and D-Sub for connectivity with multiple peripherals and displays. With dual M.2 slots, the GIGABYTE B760M H supports high-speed SSDs for faster data access, making it ideal for users seeking a compact yet capable motherboard.

 Stable and Versatile in a Compact Form

 Built on the Intel B760 chipset, the GIGABYTE B760M H is designed to provide stable and efficient performance in a range of applications. Its mATX form factor fits easily into smaller cases, offering flexibility without sacrificing essential features. This motherboard also supports ECC and non-ECC memory modules for improved stability in professional environments.

 Choose the GIGABYTE B760M H for a Compact, Powerful Build

 With support for Intel’s latest processors, DDR4, PCIe 4.0, and dual M.2 slots, the GIGABYTE B760M H mATX motherboard is an excellent choice for a reliable, space-saving setup. Order yours today to experience compact performance built for gaming and productivity.

whiteangel-wgugcb.description:
🔹 Description: 

 Unlock dependable performance and modern connectivity for your next PC build with the ASUS PRIME B760M-R D4 motherboard — a compact Micro-ATX powerhouse designed to support 13th and 12th Gen Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold, and Celeron® processors . With advanced power solutions, comprehensive cooling, and support for the latest technologies, this board offers everything you need for a reliable and efficient system—whether you’re building for gaming, content creation, or productivity.

 
 ✅ Optimized for Intel 13th & 12th Gen CPUs 

 Built on the Intel B760 chipset , the PRIME B760M-R D4 supports the powerful LGA1700 socket , making it fully compatible with Intel’s latest 13th Gen (Raptor Lake) and 12th Gen (Alder Lake) CPUs. These modern processors offer a hybrid architecture with performance and efficiency cores—ideal for multitasking and demanding applications.

 This board allows you to unleash the full potential of your CPU with a stable power delivery system featuring 6+1 DrMOS power stages , high-quality capacitors , and robust VRM cooling.

 
 🧠 DDR4 Memory Support for Performance and Affordability 

 The PRIME B760M-R D4 supports up to 128GB of DDR4 memory across 2 DIMM slots , with speeds up to DDR4 5333 MHz (OC) . This allows for blazing-fast application loading, smooth multitasking, and consistent performance, all while maintaining cost-effectiveness compared to DDR5-based systems.

 Whether you’re gaming, editing, or streaming, this board gives you the memory bandwidth needed for smooth performance.

 
 ⚡ PCIe 4.0 & Dual M.2 for Fast Storage and Graphics 

 The motherboard includes:

 
• 
 1 x PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for your graphics card

• 
 2 x M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4 slots for ultra-fast NVMe SSDs

• 
 4 x SATA 6Gb/s ports for traditional storage devices

 
 The dual M.2 slots enable fast boot times and speedy file transfers, while PCIe 4.0 ensures compatibility with current and next-gen GPUs for gaming and creative work.

 
 🌬️ Comprehensive Cooling with AI Fan Control 

 ASUS knows that thermal performance is essential. The B760M-R D4 is equipped with:

 
• 
 Large VRM and chipset heatsinks

• 
 Multiple 4-pin PWM/DC fan headers 

• 
 AI Cooling and Fan Xpert 2+ software

• 
 Dedicated AIO pump header

 
 Together, these features ensure efficient heat dissipation even under full system load. You can customize your fan profiles or let ASUS software intelligently manage cooling based on system usage.

 
 🔌 Modern Connectivity & I/O Options 

 Despite its compact Micro-ATX form factor, the ASUS PRIME B760M-R D4 doesn’t skimp on connectivity:

 
• 
 6 x USB ports (including USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A)

• 
 DisplayPort and HDMI outputs for integrated graphics

• 
 Intel® Gigabit Ethernet for stable wired networking

• 
 Front panel USB 3.2 Gen 1 header 

• 
 Audio jacks powered by Realtek ALC897 chipset 

 
 These features make it ideal for general users, gamers, and business professionals looking for fast and reliable data transfer and device compatibility.

 
 🛡️ ASUS 5X Protection III – Built to Last 

 Durability and protection are at the heart of ASUS motherboards. The PRIME B760M-R D4 comes with ASUS 5X Protection III , a suite of hardware safeguards including:

 
• 
 SafeSlot Core to prevent GPU sag and damage

• 
 Overvoltage and overcurrent protection for RAM and CPU 

• 
 Stainless-steel I/O shield for corrosion resistance

• 
 ESD Guards for USB and LAN ports

• 
 DIGI+ VRM for precise power delivery

 
 This makes the motherboard not just powerful, but also extremely reliable for long-term use.

 
 🔧 Easy PC Building Experience 

 ASUS makes DIY easy for beginners and advanced users alike. With Q-LEDs for quick diagnostics, an intuitive UEFI BIOS , and pre-configured fan controls, you’ll find setup and configuration to be seamless.

 The board also supports BIOS FlashBack™ , allowing you to update the BIOS without installing a CPU or RAM—a feature usually reserved for high-end boards.

 
 🎯 Perfect

MSI PRO B760M-E DDR5 Micro-ATX Motherboard

 The MSI PRO B760M-E DDR5 Motherboard is a highly efficient, business-class Micro-ATX platform powered by the Intel B760 chipset, engineered specifically to support 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold, and Celeron® processors on the LGA 1700 socket. Designed to bring high-speed DDR5 memory performance and PCIe 4.0 expansion capabilities into an accessible, compact form factor, the PRO B760M-E provides an ideal, stable foundation for productivity workstations, office PCs, and everyday gaming systems.

 Equipped with MSI’s Core Boost and Memory Boost technologies, high-quality power components, and efficient passive VRM cooling, this motherboard maintains continuous electrical stability and thermal management during daily multitasking and heavy workloads. Combined with ultra-fast PCIe 4.0 M.2 storage support, high-speed Gigabit LAN, HDMI and VGA display outputs, and user-friendly EZ DIY diagnostic features, the MSI PRO B760M-E DDR5 strikes the ultimate balance between essential connectivity, reliability, and value.

 
 
 
 
 Next-Gen DDR5 Memory Performance & Memory Boost

 High-Bandwidth Operations for Superior Multitasking and System Speed

 Step into the modern era of high-speed system memory with native DDR5 support. The MSI PRO B760M-E features dual DDR5 DIMM slots capable of supporting memory frequencies up to DDR5-6400+ (OC), delivering significantly higher bandwidth and efficiency compared to legacy DDR4 architecture.

 Utilizing MSI’s fully isolated Memory Boost circuitry, memory signal traces are shielded from external noise, ensuring pure digital data signals for optimal stability and system performance under extreme multitasking workloads.

 
 PCIe 4.0 Expansion & Steel Armor Protection

 Maximum Bandwidth for Dedicated Graphics Cards with Reinforced Slot Durability

 The motherboard is equipped with a primary PCIe 4.0 x16 slot, providing double the transmission speed of PCIe 3.0 standards to fully feed high-performance dedicated graphics cards with maximum bandwidth.

 To protect your investment, the primary PCIe slot is built with MSI Steel Armor, featuring heavy-duty solder points and physical metal reinforcement to safeguard the PCB against heavy GPU bending and electromagnetic interference (EMI).

 
 Ultra-Fast Lightning Gen 4 M.2 Storage

 High-Speed NVMe SSD Performance for Quick Boot Times and Application Loads

 Accelerate your operating system boot times and software application loads with onboard Lightning Gen 4 M.2 storage support. Operating at PCIe 4.0 x4 speeds, the M.2 slot delivers transfer rates up to 64Gb/s when paired with modern NVMe SSDs.

 Additionally, multiple SATA 6Gb/s ports provide flexible storage expansion for high-capacity hard drives and secondary 2.5-inch SSD storage setups.

 
 Reliable Power Architecture & EZ Debug LEDs

 Optimized Core Power Delivery and Simplified System Diagnostics

 Built with MSI’s proprietary Core Boost architecture, the PRO B760M-E combines a precise digital power design with 8-pin CPU power input to deliver clean, unthrottled current to the processor with maximum precision.

 Troubleshooting hardware issues during assembly is fast and intuitive thanks to integrated EZ Debug LEDs. Onboard indicator LEDs for CPU, DRAM, VGA, and BOOT quickly signal the exact component source of any startup issue.

Compact Performance and Versatility for Modern Builds

 The ASUS PRIME B760M-K DDR5 motherboard is designed for users looking to maximize their system’s performance while maintaining a compact mATX form factor. Featuring the Intel B760 chipset, DDR5 memory support, and compatibility with Intel's 12th and 13th Gen processors, this motherboard is perfect for gaming, content creation, and general productivity.

 
 

 Key Features

 
• 
 Intel® LGA 1700 Socket (12th/13th Gen)

• 
 DDR5 Memory Support (Up to 64GB) 

 
• Experience faster memory speeds with DDR5 support, offering up to 64GB capacity and up to 6400MHz (OC) speeds, ideal for demanding workloads.

 

• 
 PCIe 4.0 x16 Slot 

 
• Equipped with a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for modern graphics cards, delivering exceptional gaming and graphical performance with enhanced bandwidth.

 

• 
 Efficient Storage Solutions 

 
• Offers one M.2 slot with PCIe 4.0 support and four SATA 6Gb/s ports for fast data transfer and efficient storage management.

 

• 
 Comprehensive Cooling 

 
• Includes multiple fan headers and dedicated heatsinks to ensure your system remains cool and stable, even during intensive tasks.

 

• 
 Connectivity 

 
• Features USB 3.2 Gen 2, USB 3.2 Gen 1, and HDMI, ensuring that you have ample options for connecting external devices and displays.

 

• 
 Durability & Protection 

 
• ASUS 5X Protection III provides a range of safety features to protect your motherboard from power surges, short circuits, and physical damage.

 

• 
 UEFI BIOS & BIOS Flashback 

 
• The UEFI BIOS offers an intuitive interface for system tuning, and BIOS Flashback allows for easy BIOS updates without a CPU installed.

 Its combination of PCIe 4.0 support, M.2 NVMe storage, advanced cooling, and ASUS reliability makes it one of the best motherboard choices for mid-range gaming PCs and productivity systems.

Celeron processors

Student setups

Productivity workstations

Everyday home systems

 The motherboard supports:

 High-speed DDR4 memory

Dual-channel configuration

XMP memory profiles

Large memory capacities

AMD Radeon GPUs

PCIe Gen4 SSDs

 Advanced Cooling Design

Optimized airflow layout

Hardware lifespan

Improved productivity workflows

MSI PRO B650M-P AM5 Micro-ATX Motherboard

 The MSI PRO B650M-P Micro-ATX Motherboard is a highly reliable, cost-effective foundation engineered to harness the computing capabilities of AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors. Built on the cutting-edge AMD AM5 socket and B650 chipset, this motherboard combines essential digital power delivery, high-speed DDR5 memory support, PCIe 4.0 expansion, and ultra-fast M.2 NVMe storage interface options to deliver rock-solid stability and efficiency for business workstations, home PCs, and compact gaming rigs.

 Meticulously designed for modern micro-ATX PC builds, the MSI PRO B650M-P incorporates MSI’s signature Core Boost technology, high-grade circuit designs, and intelligent Frozr AI Cooling controls to keep critical power delivery components running cool under sustained workloads. Featuring 2.5G Realtek LAN, reversible USB 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps) Type-C ports, triple display outputs (DisplayPort 1.4, HDMI 2.1, and VGA), and Steel Armor reinforced PCIe slots, this motherboard provides the durability, speed, and versatility needed to power daily productivity and gaming setups.

 
 
 
 
 Digital Power Design & Core Boost Technology

 Stable and Efficient Power Delivery for AMD Socket AM5 Processors

 At the core of the MSI PRO B650M-P is an optimized digital power delivery architecture featuring Core Boost technology. Combining a refined layout with a precise digital PWM controller, this motherboard ensures clean, rapid, and undistorted power delivery directly to multi-core AMD Ryzen CPUs during intensive productivity tasks or gaming sessions.

 To maintain thermal efficiency during continuous operation, the motherboard features heavy VRM heatsinks and thermal pads that dissipate operational heat away from critical power phases, preventing thermal throttling and ensuring long-term system stability.

 
 High-Speed DDR5 Memory Boost Up to 6000+ MHz (OC)

 Unlocking High-Bandwidth Next-Gen Memory Performance with AMD EXPO

 Step into the next generation of multi-tasking speed with support for high-speed DDR5 memory modules across 4 DIMM slots , supporting up to 192GB of total system RAM. Utilizing MSI Memory Boost technology, the memory trace lines are routed through an isolated PCB layer to eliminate signal noise and deliver pure data transmission for maximum stability.

 With full support for AMD EXPO™ (Extended Profiles for Overclocking) and Intel® XMP memory profiles, users can effortlessly enable pre-tuned high-frequency memory settings in BIOS with a single click to achieve lower latency and massive bandwidth gains.

 
 PCIe 4.0 Expansion & Dual Lightning M.2 NVMe Slots

 64Gbps Storage Bandwidth paired with Steel Armor Slot Protection

 Eliminate system boot bottlenecks and load heavy applications instantly. The PRO B650M-P houses dual M.2 PCIe 4.0 x4 storage slots delivering transfer speeds up to 64Gbps, making it the ideal platform for high-performance NVMe solid-state drives.

 The primary PCIe 4.0 x16 expansion slot features MSI Steel Armor structural reinforcement anchored to the PCB with additional solder points. This design shields the slot from physical bending caused by modern graphics cards while protecting signals against electromagnetic interference (EMI).

 
 Realtek 2.5Gbps LAN & High-Speed I/O Connectivity

 Ultra-Fast Wired Networking and Reversible USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-C

 Experience low-latency networking and rapid file transfers with the onboard Realtek 2.5G LAN controller . Delivering up to 2.5 times the speed of traditional Gigabit Ethernet, this interface provides smooth online gaming, faster cloud backups, and high-speed local network file sharing.

 The rear I/O panel includes high-speed USB 3.2 Gen 2 (10Gbps) Type-C and Type-A ports for modern external storage drives, along with a triple video output setup featuring DisplayPort 1.4, HDMI 2.1, and VGA for flexible multi-monitor display configurations.

ASRock B760M Pro RS Intel LGA 1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard

 The ASRock B760M Pro RS is a feature-rich Micro-ATX motherboard engineered to release the full performance potential of 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold, and Celeron® processors. Built on the Intel LGA 1700 socket and B760 chipset, this motherboard combines a 7+1+1 Dr.MOS power phase design, ultra-fast DDR5 memory overclocking support up to 7200+ MHz (OC), PCIe 5.0 graphics expansion, and Dragon 2.5Gb Ethernet for exceptional gaming and productivity performance.

 Designed with a sleek white-and-silver aesthetic on a black PCB, this motherboard integrates comprehensive thermal management equipped with extra-large alloy VRM heatsinks and dual M.2 thermal guards. Featuring Nahimic Audio enhancement, front-panel USB 3.2 Gen1 Type-C connectivity, and Polychrome SYNC RGB header customization, this hardware platform delivers high-speed storage, network efficiency, and long-term stability for custom PC builders.

 
 
 

 

 
 7+1+1 Power Phase Design with Integrated Dr.MOS Technology

 Clean Energy Delivery and Optimized Thermal Efficiency for Intel CPUs

 At the core of the ASRock B760M Pro RS is a robust 7+1+1 Power Phase VRM architecture incorporating Smart Power Stage Dr.MOS technology. Engineered to provide smooth, uninterrupted power directly to multi-core Intel processors, this power delivery solution maximizes system stability during heavy gaming loads and intensive multithreaded workflows.

 To keep component temperatures low under sustained processing loads, the VRM section is shielded by massive aluminum heatsinks that swiftly pull thermal buildup away from crucial power components.

 

 
 Next-Gen Dual Channel DDR5 Memory Support Up to 7200+ MHz (OC)

 Unlocking Ultra-Fast RAM Bandwidth with Intel XMP 3.0 Profiles

 Unlock high-speed RAM throughput with 4 DIMM slots supporting up to 192GB of dual-channel DDR5 memory. Featuring optimized memory signal tracing, this board enables users to easily trigger memory frequencies exceeding 7200+ MHz (OC).

 PCIe Gen5 GPU Bandwidth alongside High-Speed NVMe Storage Interfaces

 Future-proof your desktop build with a primary PCIe 5.0 x16 slot, providing double the bandwidth compared to PCIe 4.0 generation hardware. The slot features steel anchor reinforcement to securely hold heavy high-end graphics cards while shielding signals against electromagnetic interference.

 For high-speed game load times, two Hyper M.2 slots deliver PCIe Gen4 x4 speeds up to 64 Gbps for modern NVMe solid-state drives, protected by integrated M.2 aluminum heatsinks.

 

 
 Dragon 2.5Gbps LAN & Dedicated M.2 Key E Slot for Wi-Fi Expansion

 Low-Latency Network Bandwidth paired with Flexible Wireless Upgradability

MSI B760M GAMING PLUS WIFI LGA 1700 Micro-ATX Motherboard

 The MSI B760M GAMING PLUS WIFI Micro-ATX Motherboard is a feature-packed, high-performance foundation engineered to unleash the full computing potential of 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen Intel Core processors. Built on the Intel B760 chipset and LGA 1700 socket, this micro-ATX powerhouse combines an upgraded 12+1+1 Duet Rail Power System, high-speed DDR5 memory support up to 6800+ MHz (OC), Lightning Gen 4 PCIe 4.0 expansion, and cutting-edge Wi-Fi 6E connectivity to deliver rock-solid stability and speed for gaming PCs and compact workstations.

 Meticulously designed for modern mATX gaming builds, the MSI B760M GAMING PLUS WIFI incorporates heavy-plated Extended Heatsinks and built-in M.2 Shield Frozr thermal solutions to keep critical VRMs and high-speed M.2 NVMe SSDs running cool under heavy workloads. Featuring 2.5G Realtek LAN, front-panel USB Type-C, quad video outputs (dual HDMI 2.1 and dual DisplayPort 1.4), and Steel Armor reinforced PCIe slots, this motherboard provides the durability, speed, and connectivity required to anchor modern battle stations.

 
 
 
 
 12+1+1 Duet Rail Power System & Core Boost

 Sustained High-Performance Energy Delivery for Intel Multi-Core Processors

 At the core of the MSI B760M GAMING PLUS WIFI is an advanced 12+1+1 Duet Rail Power System (DRPS) with P-PAK , backed by dual CPU power connectors. Driven by MSI’s exclusive Core Boost technology and a digital PWM circuit layout, this motherboard delivers clean, precise, and uninterrupted voltage to multi-core Intel Core CPUs during intensive gaming, streaming, and rendering tasks.

MSI B850M-P WIFI Micro-ATX Gaming Motherboard

 The MSI B850M-P WIFI Motherboard is a powerful, feature-packed Micro-ATX platform built on AMD’s B850 chipset, engineered specifically to unleash the full performance of AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 series desktop processors. Designed for gamers, system builders, and productivity users, this motherboard integrates next-generation PCIe 5.0 graphics bandwidth, ultra-fast DDR5 memory support, and ultra-high-speed connectivity into a compact, highly reliable build layout.

 Featuring a high-efficiency digital power design, extended thermal heatsinks, and dedicated M.2 Shield Frozr cooling, the MSI B850M-P WIFI delivers consistent power delivery and low operating temperatures under heavy gaming loads. Enhanced with cutting-edge Wi-Fi 7 wireless networking, ultra-fast 5Gbps LAN, and MSI’s innovative EZ DIY tool-less installation features, this motherboard is the ultimate backbone for modern AM5 compact desktop builds.

 
 
 
 
 Robust Power Delivery & Efficient VRM Cooling

 Stable Core Power for High-Performance AMD Ryzen™ Processors

 To support high-core-count multi-threaded CPUs and sustained boost frequencies, the MSI B850M-P WIFI utilizes a direct digital power delivery system with solid power stages. This ensures precise, ripple-free voltage delivery to the AM5 socket, maintaining uninterrupted power stability during intense gaming and heavy rendering tasks.

 The VRM power section is covered by heavy-duty aluminium heatsinks with premium thermal pads to conduct heat away from critical power components rapidly, preserving efficiency and long-term hardware reliability.

 
 PCIe 5.0 Steel Armor Slot & Extreme DDR5 Boost

 Maximum Bandwidth for Modern GPUs and Ultra-Fast Memory Speeds

 Equipped with a primary PCIe 5.0 x16 expansion slot, the motherboard delivers double the throughput of PCIe 4.0, providing future-proof support for top-tier graphics cards. The slot is reinforced with MSI Steel Armor technology to protect the slot against heavy GPU weight and electromagnetic interference (EMI).

 With 4x DDR5 DIMM slots supporting memory speeds up to DDR5-8200+ (OC), users can leverage AMD EXPO™ profiles for simple, one-click memory overclocking. MSI’s isolated Memory Boost circuit design ensures clean signal transmission for maximum system stability.

 
 Triple M.2 Storage Capability & M.2 Shield Frozr

 Lightning-Fast Storage Speeds with Dedicated Thermal Protection

 The B850M-P WIFI features three high-speed M.2 slots, including a primary PCIe 5.0 x4 M.2 slot directly connected to the CPU for blazing NVMe storage performance. Additional PCIe 4.0 M.2 slots allow for expansive ultra-fast storage drive expansion.

 To prevent thermal throttling on high-performance NVMe SSDs, the primary M.2 slot is shielded by MSI’s EZ M.2 Shield Frozr II heatsink, ensuring sustained peak read/write speeds even under heavy file transfers.

 
 Next-Gen Connectivity: Wi-Fi 7, 5GbE LAN & EZ DIY Features

 Ultra-Fast Wireless/Wired Networking and Tool-Free Hardware Assembly

 Experience next-level networking speeds with built-in Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be), delivering multi-gigabit wireless speeds and low-latency performance across the 6GHz band. For ultra-fast wired connections, the onboard Realtek 5Gbps LAN port guarantees fast online gaming and rapid local network data transfers.

 System assembly is effortless thanks to MSI’s EZ DIY innovations, including the EZ PCIe Clip II for easy GPU removal, tool-less EZ M.2 clips, and onboard EZ Debug LEDs for quick system status diagnostics. 

 
 
 
 Why Choose MSI B850M-P WIFI Motherboard?

 PCIe 5.0 Power, DDR5 Speeds, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G LAN in a Micro-ATX Form Factor

 The MSI B850M-P WIFI Micro-ATX Motherboard delivers an incredible combination of high-speed PCIe 5.0 graphics support, Wi-Fi 7 readiness, 5G LAN, and robust VRM power delivery on the modern AM5 socket. It provides everything needed to build a powerful compact gaming or productivity desktop.

Engineered with solid-pin power connectors and premium chokes, this power delivery architecture supplies clean, precise, and consistent voltage directly to multi-core AMD Ryzen processors during intensive multi-threaded workloads and high-frame-rate gaming.

Built on the cutting-edge AMD AM5 platform, this motherboard combines high-efficiency power delivery, next-generation DDR5 memory support, and ultra-fast PCIe 5.0 M.2 storage capabilities to deliver exceptional stability and speed for gaming enthusiasts, content creators, and system builders alike.

whiteangel-1yl0vuv.description:
ASUS TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard

 The ASUS TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard is a robust, high-performance foundation engineered to harness the full processing power of AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors. Built on AMD’s advanced AM5 socket and B850 chipset, this full-sized ATX motherboard combines an 8+2+1 80A DrMOS power stage architecture, high-speed DDR5 memory overclocking support up to 8000+ MT/s, PCIe 5.0 graphics expansion, and integrated Wi-Fi 6E wireless networking to deliver military-grade reliability and speed for full-tower gaming builds and demanding workstations.

 Meticulously designed for modern gaming battle stations, the TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI incorporates an advanced thermal ecosystem equipped with enlarged VRM heatsinks and flexible M.2 thermal protection to maintain low component temperatures under heavy gaming sessions. Featuring Realtek 2.5GbE Ethernet with TUF LANGuard, front-panel USB 20Gbps Type-C® connectivity, toolless PCIe Slot Q-Release mechanisms, and user-friendly BIOS FlashBack™, this motherboard delivers the endurance, speed, and DIY convenience needed to power next-generation PC builds.

 
 
 
 
 8+2+1 (80A) DrMOS Power Phase Architecture & Military-Grade TUF Components

 Robust Power Stability and Heavy-Duty Energy Delivery for AMD AM5 CPUs

 At the core of the ASUS TUF GAMING B850-E WIFI is an advanced 8+2+1 DrMOS power stage design rated for 80A per stage . Engineered with an 8-layer PCB, ProCool power connectors, TUF 5K black metallic capacitors, and Digi+ VRM voltage regulation, this power architecture supplies clean, precise, and consistent voltage directly to multi-core AMD Ryzen processors during intensive multi-threaded workloads and high-frame-rate gaming.

 To dissipate heat rapidly, the VRM components are covered by enlarged heatsinks that draw thermal energy away from critical power phases, preventing thermal throttling and extending hardware component longevity.

 
 Dual Channel DDR5 Memory Support Up to 8000+ MT/s (OC)

 Unlocking High-Bandwidth Memory Speeds with AMD EXPO & AEMP Support

 Step into the future of system responsiveness with support for high-frequency DDR5 memory modules across 4 DIMM slots , supporting up to 256GB of total system RAM. The motherboard features isolated memory trace routing and ASUS Enhanced Memory Profile (AEMP) tuning to ensure maximum signal integrity and reliable overclocking headroom.

 With full compatibility for AMD EXPO™ (Extended Profiles for Overclocking), gamers and creators can easily trigger pre-tuned high-frequency memory profiles in BIOS with a single click, achieving lower latencies and massive memory bandwidth.

 
 PCIe 5.0 Expansion & Triple M.2 Storage Matrix

whiteangel-xg0qy.description:
GIGABYTE B650 GAMING X AX V2 AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard

 The GIGABYTE B650 GAMING X AX V2 AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard is a feature-rich, high-performance platform engineered to unleash the full power of AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors. Built on the modern AMD AM5 socket and B650 chipset, this motherboard combines a heavy-duty Direct Digital VRM power design, high-speed DDR5 memory support, PCIe 5.0 M.2 storage capabilities, and integrated Wi-Fi 6E connectivity to deliver unwavering stability and extreme responsiveness for competitive gaming, streaming, and content creation.

 Meticulously designed to anchor full-tower and mid-tower battle stations, the GIGABYTE B650 GAMING X AX V2 features an enlarged thermal architecture equipped with fully covered MOSFET heatsinks and specialized M.2 Thermal Guards to keep critical components cool during intense gaming sessions. Featuring 2.5GbE Realtek LAN, USB 3.2 Gen 2×2 Type-C performance, PCIe EZ-Latch quick-release mechanisms, and user-friendly Q-Flash Plus BIOS updating, this motherboard offers the reliability, speed, and DIY convenience needed to power next-generation PC builds.

 
 
 
 
 Direct 8+2+2 Digital VRM Power Phase Architecture

 Robust Power Stability and Clean Energy Delivery with 60A DrMOS

 At the core of the GIGABYTE B650 GAMING X AX V2 is an advanced Direct 8+2+2 digital power VRM design featuring 60A DrMOS power stages. Engineered with premium solid-pin power connectors and high-efficiency chokes, this power delivery system supplies clean, precise, and consistent voltage directly to multi-core AMD Ryzen CPUs during heavy multi-threaded workloads and high-frame-rate gaming.

 To dissipate heat rapidly, the VRM architecture is covered by massive, fully integrated MOSFET heatsinks connected with high-conductivity 5W/mK thermal pads, preventing thermal throttling and extending hardware component longevity. 

 
 Dual Channel DDR5 Memory with AMD EXPO & XMP Support

 Unlocking Next-Gen Memory Speeds Up to 8000+ MHz (OC)

 Step into the future of system responsiveness with support for high-frequency DDR5 memory modules across 4 DIMM slots , supporting up to 256GB of system RAM. The motherboard features isolated memory trace routing and daisy-chain topology to ensure maximum signal integrity and effortless overclocking headroom.

 With full compatibility for both AMD EXPO™ (Extended Profiles for Overclocking) and Intel® XMP memory profiles, players and creators can easily trigger pre-tuned high-frequency memory settings in BIOS with a single click, achieving low latencies and massive memory bandwidth. 

 
 Blazing Fast M.2 Storage Matrix with PCIe 5.0 Support

 PCIe 5.0 x4 M.2 Slot paired with Dual PCIe 4.0 M.2 Storage Slots

 Eliminate game loading screens and transfer large media files in seconds. The B650 GAMING X AX V2 comes equipped with three M.2 storage connectors , including a primary PCIe 5.0 x4 M.2 slot capable of reaching next-gen SSD speeds up to 14,000MB/s.

 To prevent thermal throttling on high-speed NVMe drives, the primary slot features an integrated M.2 Thermal Guard heatsink. Additionally, the motherboard incorporates PCIe EZ-Latch mechanisms, allowing you to install or swap out graphics cards effortlessly without dealing with tight space constraints.

 
 High-Speed Wi-Fi 6E Wireless & 2.5Gbps Realtek Ethernet

 Dedicated 6GHz Band Wireless Communication and Ultra-Low Latency Wired LAN

 Stay connected with wire-like stability using onboard Wi-Fi 6E 802.11ax wireless networking . Operating across the dedicated 6GHz frequency band, Wi-Fi 6E dramatically reduces signal congestion and interference, delivering smoother wireless online gaming, fast file transfers, and high-bitrate streaming.

 For competitive gamers who demand a rock-solid wired connection, the Realtek 2.5GbE LAN controller provides ultra-low pings and high-bandwidth ethernet performance. Integrated Bluetooth 5.3 allows for easy pairing with wireless headsets and peripherals.

Built for Modern AMD Gaming Performance

 The MSI B850 GAMING PRO WIFI6E is a powerful ATX motherboard built for users who want a modern AMD platform with dependable gaming performance, fast connectivity, and strong long-term value. Designed around the AMD B850 chipset and AM5 socket, it supports AMD Ryzen 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series desktop processors, making it a strong choice for gaming PCs, streaming systems, productivity builds, and high-performance everyday desktops. It is designed to deliver a balance between practical value and premium hardware support, giving builders a stable and capable foundation for a modern PC.

 The MSI B850 GAMING PRO WIFI6E supports dual-channel DDR5 memory with speeds up to 8200+ MT/s when overclocked. This gives users access to the speed, responsiveness, and bandwidth expected from a current-generation AM5 platform. DDR5 support helps improve system responsiveness in gaming, multitasking, content consumption, and heavier workloads, making this motherboard a smart option for users who want a system that feels fast and ready for demanding daily use.

 Strong Power Design for Stable Daily Use

 MSI equips the B850 GAMING PRO WIFI6E with a 12 Duet Rail Power System using 55A DrMOS stages, along with dual 8-pin CPU power connectors, Core Boost, Memory Boost, and a 6-layer PCB made with 2oz thickened copper. These features are important for users who care about system stability, consistent power delivery, and reliable performance during gaming sessions, multitasking, and sustained workloads. This makes the board a solid choice for users building around modern Ryzen processors and expecting dependable long-term performance.

 Fast Storage Support for a More Responsive System

 Storage speed has a major impact on how a system feels in daily use, and the MSI B850 GAMING PRO WIFI6E includes support for a PCIe 5.0 x4 M.2 solution. Faster storage means shorter boot times, quicker game loading, smoother file access, and a more responsive desktop experience overall. The board includes Wi-Fi 6E for fast and stable wireless connectivity, along with 2.5G LAN for users who prefer high-speed wired networking. GIGABYTE B650E EAGLE WIFI 6E Gaming Motherboard

 The GIGABYTE B650E EAGLE WIFI 6E Motherboard is a high-performance, future-proof ATX platform built on the AMD B650E chipset, engineered specifically to unleash the full power of AMD Ryzen™ 7000, 8000, and 9000 series processors. Designed for gamers, creators, and hardware enthusiasts seeking elite performance without compromises, the B650E EAGLE integrates next-generation PCIe 5.0 expansion lanes, high-speed DDR5 memory support, and ultra-fast wireless connectivity into a durable, stealthy black aesthetic.

 Featuring a robust digital VRM power phase design, advanced thermal armor, and dedicated PCIe 5.0 M.2 slots for high-speed NVMe storage, this motherboard provides rock-solid electrical power delivery and thermal stability under prolonged heavy workloads. Enhanced with integrated Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5GbE LAN, DIY-friendly EZ-Latch hardware installation features, and customizable RGB Fusion lighting control, the GIGABYTE B650E EAGLE WIFI 6E serves as the ultimate backbone for modern AM5 gaming builds.

 
 
 
 
 Advanced Power Architecture & Robust Digital VRM

 Uncompromised Power Delivery for AMD Ryzen™ High-Core Processors

 To support heavy multi-threaded processing and sustained precision boost frequencies, the GIGABYTE B650E EAGLE WIFI 6E utilizes a premium digital VRM power design equipped with high-current power stages. This ensures precise, clean voltage delivery directly to the AM5 socket, maintaining low power loss and steady current delivery during extreme gaming loads or intensive rendering applications.

 The high-grade 8+2+2 phase VRM configuration is built with premium solid capacitors, alloy chokes, and 2oz copper PCB layers, offering superior electrical conductivity, enhanced signal integrity, and lower overall system operating temperatures.

 
 Next-Generation PCIe 5.0 Support & High-Speed DDR5 Memory

 Future-Proof Graphics Bandwidth and Ultra-Fast Memory Speeds

 As part of AMD’s B650E (Extreme) chipset family, this motherboard features a dedicated PCIe 5.0 x16 slot for next-generation graphics cards, offering double the bandwidth of PCIe 4.0 standards. The main PCIe slot is reinforced with GIGABYTE PCIe Armor to prevent PCB bending and support heavy enthusiast GPUs securely.

 The board supports dual-channel DDR5 memory with AMD EXPO™ (Extended Profiles for Overclocking) and Intel® XMP compatibility. Accelerated memory traces optimized via Daisy-Chain routing allow users to achieve blazing-fast memory frequencies with minimal latency for smooth multitasking and fluid frame rates. 

 
 Comprehensive Thermal Management & Ultra-Fast NVMe Storage

 Integrated Thermal Armor and PCIe 5.0 M.2 Expansion Capability

 To keep high-speed components running at maximum efficiency, the motherboard features extended VRM heatsinks and high-conductivity thermal pads to dissipate heat rapidly. Multiple high-speed M.2 slots—including a primary PCIe 5.0 x4 M.2 slot—are shielded by dedicated M.2 Thermal Guards to prevent thermal throttling on ultra-fast Gen5 and Gen4 SSDs.

 Equipped with Smart Fan 6 technology, users gain complete control over internal system cooling. Multiple temperature sensors positioned across the board work alongside hybrid fan headers supporting PWM and DC pumps to deliver customized fan curves and whisper-quiet operation. 

 
 Next-Gen Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6E, 2.5GbE LAN & EZ-Latch Design

 High-Bandwidth Networking and Simplified DIY System Assembly

 Experience ultra-smooth online gaming and rapid file transfers with integrated Wi-Fi 6E module operating across the dedicated 6GHz band for minimal signal interference. For low-latency wired connections, the onboard 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet LAN port delivers high-speed network performance for competitive multiplayer gaming and network storage management.

GIGABYTE X870 GAMING X WIFI7 AM5 ATX Gaming Motherboard

 The GIGABYTE X870 GAMING X WIFI7 ATX Gaming Motherboard is a high-performance, next-generation foundation engineered to unleash the full computing capabilities of AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors. Built on the modern AMD AM5 platform and X870 chipset, this motherboard combines a heavy-duty Digital Twin 16+2+2 VRM power solution, high-speed DDR5 memory overclocking support exceeding 8200+ MT/s, PCIe 5.0 graphics expansion, and cutting-edge Wi-Fi 7 wireless networking to deliver rock-solid stability and speed for competitive gamers and content creators.

 Meticulously designed for modern desktop battle stations, the X870 GAMING X WIFI7 features GIGABYTE’s VRM Thermal Armor Advanced cooling architecture, complete with M.2 Thermal Guard Ext. heatsinks to keep critical power phases and fast NVMe SSDs running cool under sustained heavy workloads. Packed with user-friendly EZ DIY features—including EZ-Latch Plus toolless PCIe and M.2 installation, Wi-Fi EZ-Plug antenna connection, dual USB4® 40Gbps Type-C ports, and Realtek 2.5GbE LAN—this motherboard provides the durability, extreme bandwidth, and DIY convenience needed to power next-generation PC builds.

 
 
 
 
 Digital Twin 16+2+2 VRM Power Phase Architecture

 Robust Power Stability and Clean Energy Delivery for AMD Ryzen 9000 & 7000 Series CPUs

 At the core of the GIGABYTE X870 GAMING X WIFI7 is an advanced Digital Twin 16(8+8 parallel)+2+2 phase VRM power system . Engineered with a 2X Copper 6-layer PCB, premium solid-pin power connectors, and high-efficiency chokes, this power delivery architecture supplies clean, precise, and consistent voltage directly to multi-core AMD Ryzen processors during intensive 4K gaming or heavy multi-threaded rendering workloads.

 To dissipate heat rapidly during sustained heavy loads, the power components are shielded by VRM Thermal Armor Advanced heatsinks equipped with high-conductivity 5W/mK thermal pads, preventing thermal throttling and extending hardware component longevity.

 
 Dual Channel DDR5 Memory Support Up to 8200+ MT/s (OC)

 Unlocking Next-Gen High-Bandwidth Speeds with AMD EXPO & XMP Support

 Step into the future of system responsiveness with support for high-frequency DDR5 memory modules across 4 DIMM slots , supporting up to 256GB of total system RAM. Utilizing GIGABYTE’s isolated PCB trace layout and signal protection, the motherboard delivers pure data transmission for maximum memory overclocking stability and lower latencies.

 With full compatibility for both AMD EXPO™ (Extended Profiles for Overclocking) and Intel® XMP memory profiles, players and creators can easily trigger pre-tuned high-frequency memory profiles in BIOS with a single click.

 
 PCIe 5.0 Expansion Slot & Triple M.2 Storage Matrix

 Blazing PCIe 5.0 GPU Slot paired with Dedicated PCIe 5.0 M.2 NVMe Storage

 Prepare your build for next-generation graphics cards and storage speeds with a primary PCIe 5.0 x16 Ultra Durable expansion slot . Offering double the bandwidth of PCIe 4.0, this slot provides unhindered data throughput for high-performance discrete GPUs.

 For ultra-fast game loading times and rapid media transfers, the motherboard houses three M.2 slots, including a primary PCIe 5.0 x4 M.2 slot capable of reaching speeds up to 14,000MB/s alongside dual PCIe 4.0 M.2 connectors. M.2 Thermal Guard Ext. heatsinks protect the drives to prevent thermal throttling under continuous read/write cycles.

 
 Next-Gen Wi-Fi 7 Wireless & 2.5Gbps Realtek Ethernet

 High-Bandwidth 160MHz Wireless Communication and Low-Latency Wired LAN

 Experience revolutionary wireless speeds with onboard Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) networking . Operating across 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and ultra-wide 6GHz frequency bands with 160MHz channel support and 4K-QAM modulation, Wi-Fi 7 reduces network latency and interference, delivering wire-like stability for online multiplayer gaming and high-bitrate 4K streaming.

 The MSI MAG B850 TOMAHAWK MAX WIFI ATX Gaming Motherboard is a battle-ready, next-generation foundation engineered specifically to harvest the computing power of AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 Series processors. Built on the cutting-edge AMD AM5 platform and B850 chipset, this motherboard combines a flagship 14+2+1 Duet Rail Power System, extreme DDR5 memory overclocking support exceeding 8400+ MT/s, dual PCIe 5.0 M.2 storage slots, and ultra-fast Wi-Fi 7 with 5G LAN to deliver unwavering stability and speed for competitive gamers and high-end creators.

Driven by digital PWM controllers and a 6-layer server-grade PCB with 2oz thickened copper, this robust VRM architecture supplies clean, precise, and uninterrupted voltage directly to multi-core AMD Ryzen processors during intense 4K gaming or heavy multi-threaded rendering tasks.

 To dissipate heat rapidly during sustained heavy loads, the power stages are shielded by heavy-plated Extended Heatsinks equipped with high-conductivity 7W/mK thermal pads and additional choke pads, preventing thermal throttling and extending hardware longevity.

 Dual PCIe 5.0 M.2 Slots paired with Steel Armor II & EZ PCIe Release

 The ASUS PRIME X870-P Motherboard is a high-performance ATX platform built on AMD’s advanced X870 chipset, expertly engineered to unleash the full computing power of AMD Ryzen™ 9000, 8000, and 7000 series processors. Designed for content creators, high-end productivity, and gaming enthusiasts, the PRIME X870-P combines a refined aesthetic with next-generation PCIe 5.0 expansion, ultra-fast DDR5 memory support, and versatile USB4 connectivity.

 Featuring a 14+2+1 power stage VRM design, massive heatsinks, and comprehensive thermal management, this motherboard maintains continuous peak performance and exceptional system stability under heavy processing loads. Equipped with multiple M.2 slots, 2.5Gb Ethernet, and ASUS signature EZ DIY installation features, the PRIME X870-P serves as a future-proof foundation for high-performance AM5 builds.

 Engineered to handle the intensive power demands of multi-core Ryzen CPUs, the ASUS PRIME X870-P features a 14+2+1 power stage layout rated for high-current loads. Combined with Digi+ VRM control, this architecture guarantees precise and ripple-free power delivery directly to the AM5 socket, preventing performance throttling during intense workloads.

 To maintain low operational temperatures, the motherboard incorporates massive VRM heatsinks with high-conductivity thermal pads, alongside dedicated M.2 heatsinks that absorb and dissipate heat away from critical drive and power components.

 Next-Gen NVMe Data Speeds and High-Speed Universal Ports

 Reliable Wired Networking and Simplified Hardware Maintenance

Built for Modern Intel Performance

 The MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI is a powerful ATX motherboard designed for users who want a modern Intel platform with strong performance, fast connectivity, and dependable long-term stability. Built on the Intel Z790 chipset and LGA 1700 socket, it supports Intel Core 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen processors, making it a strong foundation for gaming PCs, productivity systems, creator builds, office workstations, and high-speed everyday desktops. With its clean PRO series design and balanced feature set, this motherboard is ideal for users who want strong hardware support without unnecessary complexity.

 DDR5 Memory Support for Faster Response

 The MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI supports DDR5 memory through four DIMM slots with a maximum capacity of 256GB. MSI lists support for memory speeds up to 7200+ MT/s when overclocked, which helps improve responsiveness in gaming, multitasking, content creation, office work, and daily heavy use. DDR5 gives users access to better bandwidth and a more modern platform, which is especially useful for builders who want stronger performance today and better upgrade value for the future.

 Strong Power Design for Stable Everyday Use

 One of the biggest strengths of the MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI is its power delivery design. MSI highlights a 16+1+1 power design with 80A Smart Power Stages , dual 8-pin CPU power connectors, a digital PWM design, and a 6-layer PCB with 2oz thickened copper. These features are important for users building around powerful Intel processors because they help maintain stability during gaming sessions, rendering, streaming, multitasking, and demanding workloads. A solid power design also adds confidence for long-term daily use, which makes this motherboard appealing for both gaming and professional systems.

 Fast Storage Support with Four M.2 Slots

 Storage performance is a major part of what makes a PC feel fast, and the MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI is well equipped for modern storage needs. MSI lists four M.2 slots along with six SATA 6Gb/s ports , giving users the flexibility to build a fast storage setup with multiple NVMe SSDs and additional hard drives or SATA SSDs. This makes the motherboard a strong option for users who want faster boot times, quicker game loading, improved file access, and plenty of storage expansion for applications, media, and work files. For users building a gaming or productivity PC, this level of storage flexibility is a major advantage.

 Lightning Gen 5 and Modern Expansion

 The MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI includes Lightning Gen 5 PCIe support, giving users a modern platform for high-performance graphics hardware and next-generation expansion. PCIe 5.0 support is an important feature for builders who want a motherboard that stays relevant longer and provides a stronger base for future upgrades. Whether the system is built for gaming, creative work, or all-around desktop performance, this level of expansion support helps make the motherboard feel more future-ready and better suited for modern components.

 WiFi 6E and 2.5G LAN for Flexible Connectivity

 Networking is another strong area for the MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI. MSI includes Wi-Fi 6E , which supports the 6GHz band on compatible networks, and 2.5G LAN for users who prefer fast and stable wired networking. This combination makes the motherboard a great choice for online gaming, streaming, large downloads, video calls, cloud-based work, and modern home or office networking. Built-in wireless support also helps create a cleaner setup by removing the need for a separate WiFi card or external adapter.

 USB 20G and Practical Connectivity

 The MSI PRO Z790-A WIFI also offers useful connectivity for modern peripherals and accessories. MSI highlights Lightning USB 20G through a rear USB 3.2 Gen 2×2 Type-C port, along with front USB Type-C support, HDMI, DisplayPort, and a practical set of internal and rear connections.  Premium Power Delivery

 16+1+1 power stages are each rated to handle up to 60 amperes, combining high-side and low-side MOSFETS and drivers into a single package to deliver power, efficiency and stable performance for all compatible Intel processors.

 

 
 
 
 

 
 AI Overclocking

GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS PRO X Wi-Fi 7 ATX Gaming Motherboard – Premium Power and Speed for Next-Gen Performance

 The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS PRO X Wi-Fi 7 ATX Gaming Motherboard is designed to support Intel’s 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen processors on the LGA1700 socket, offering a powerful base for high-performance gaming and productivity. Equipped with DDR5 memory support up to 7600MHz (O.C.), PCIe 5.0 compatibility, and the latest Wi-Fi 7, this motherboard brings unparalleled speed, stability, and future-ready technology. With 5 M.2 slots, enhanced connectivity options, and extensive expansion capabilities, the Z790 AORUS PRO X is an optimal choice for gamers and creators looking for a robust, versatile setup.

 Key Features of the GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS PRO X Wi-Fi 7 Motherboard

 
• Intel 14th, 13th, and 12th Gen Processor Compatibility – Supports Intel® Core™, Pentium® Gold, and Celeron® processors

• DDR5 Memory Speeds Up to 7600MHz (O.C.) – Four DDR5 DIMM slots supporting up to 192GB of memory

• PCIe 5.0 x16 Slot – Optimized for next-gen GPUs, providing peak performance

• Wi-Fi 7 & Ethernet – Ultra-fast, reliable internet with the latest Wi-Fi 7 and a dedicated RJ-45 port

• 5x M.2 Slots – Extensive high-speed storage options for quick data access

• Comprehensive I/O Connectivity – Includes USB 3.2 Gen 2×2, HDMI, DisplayPort, USB Type-C®, and more

 
 DDR5 and PCIe 5.0 – High-Speed Performance and Efficiency

 The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS PRO X Wi-Fi 7 maximizes performance with DDR5 memory support up to 7600MHz (O.C.), delivering faster data transfer rates and enhanced multitasking efficiency. The motherboard’s PCIe 5.0 x16 slot ensures ample bandwidth for the latest GPUs, making it ideal for resource-heavy gaming and content creation applications.

 Advanced Connectivity with Wi-Fi 7 and 5 M.2 Slots

 This motherboard offers the latest Wi-Fi 7 technology for ultra-fast, stable wireless connections and comprehensive I/O options, including USB 3.2 Gen 2×2, USB Type-C®, HDMI, and DisplayPort. Additionally, the 5 M.2 slots provide flexible, high-speed storage solutions, enabling users to store large files and applications with ease.

 Designed for Gaming, Creation, and High-Performance Use

 Built on the Intel Z790 chipset, the GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS PRO X Wi-Fi 7 delivers reliable power distribution, excellent cooling solutions, and support for Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory modules for easy overclocking. Its ATX form factor is durable and versatile, supporting advanced cooling and expansion options for both gaming and professional workloads.

 Upgrade Your Setup with the GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS PRO X Wi-Fi 7 for Unmatched Performance

 The GIGABYTE Z790 AORUS PRO X Wi-Fi 7 motherboard combines cutting-edge technology and exceptional design to create a future-proof platform for any high-performance build. Order yours today to enjoy the best in connectivity, power, and speed for gaming and beyond.

Unleash Unrivaled Performance with the ASUS ROG STRIX X870-A GAMING WIFI ATX Motherboard 

 The ASUS ROG STRIX X870-A GAMING WIFI ATX motherboard is a high-performance solution engineered for gamers, creators, and PC enthusiasts. Powered by the AMD X870 chipset and featuring support for DDR5 memory, PCIe 5.0, and integrated Wi-Fi 6E, it guarantees next-generation gaming and productivity performance. Whether you’re looking for ultimate speed, aesthetics, or future-proofing your system, this motherboard delivers everything you need and more.

 
 

 Key Features

 AMD AM5 Socket & X870 Chipset 

 
• Built for AMD Ryzen 7000 & 9000 series processors with the latest AM5 socket, offering an exceptional blend of power, performance, and multitasking capabilities.

• The X870 chipset supports advanced PCIe 5.0 technology for maximum bandwidth, ensuring your system stays at the cutting edge.

 
 DDR5 Memory Support 

 
• 4x DIMM slots with support for DDR5 memory, delivering faster speeds and higher capacities to handle even the most demanding workloads, from gaming to content creation.

• Supports up to 128GB of DDR5 memory, providing ample room for all your applications and multitasking needs.

 
 PCIe 5.0 Support 

 
• Equipped with PCIe 5.0 slots for the next generation of GPUs, storage devices, and expansion cards.

• Doubles the bandwidth of PCIe 4.0, allowing for faster data transfers, enhanced GPU performance, and quicker loading times for storage.

 
 Integrated Wi-Fi 6E 

 
• Features Wi-Fi 6E technology, offering ultra-fast wireless speeds, reduced latency, and a more stable connection for both gaming and streaming.

• Future-proof your system with the latest wireless standard, ensuring maximum performance even as wireless technologies evolve.

 
 Premium Aesthetics with White Finish 

 
• The stunning white design, along with customizable RGB lighting, makes this motherboard not only a high performer but also a visually striking addition to your build.

• The ROG design ensures a premium look and feel, while Aura Sync allows for seamless synchronization with other RGB components.

 
 Comprehensive Connectivity 

 
• Multiple M.2 slots for high-speed storage, USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 for ultra-fast data transfer, and numerous SATA ports for additional storage options.

• HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort for versatile display options, and multiple fan headers ensure efficient system cooling.

igeek-1outnnl.description:
Unleash Extreme Performance for Gaming and Content Creation

 The ASUS ROG STRIX X670E-E GAMING WIFI ATX motherboard is engineered to deliver top-tier performance and future-proofing for gamers, content creators, and enthusiasts. With support for the latest AMD Ryzen™ 7000 series processors, PCIe 5.0, DDR5 memory, and integrated Wi-Fi 6E, this motherboard provides blazing-fast speeds, advanced cooling options, and a highly customizable design to enhance your overall gaming and productivity experience.

 
 

 Key Features

 
• 
 AM5 Socket for AMD Ryzen™ 7000 Series Processors 

 
• Built for the latest AMD Ryzen™ 7000 series CPUs, featuring the powerful Zen 4 architecture, the AM5 socket supports high-performance computing for gaming, streaming, and multitasking.

 

• 
 DDR5 Memory Support (Up to 128GB) 

 
• The motherboard supports DDR5 memory up to 6400MHz (OC) for faster data transfer, increased bandwidth, and improved overall system performance.

 

• 
 PCIe 5.0 for Next-Gen Graphics and Storage 

 
• Equipped with PCIe 5.0 x16 slots, this motherboard provides double the bandwidth of PCIe 4.0, enabling next-gen GPUs and SSDs to run at peak performance.

 

• 
 Wi-Fi 6E with Bluetooth 5.2 

 
• Integrated Wi-Fi 6E delivers faster wireless speeds, lower latency, and greater bandwidth for smoother gaming and streaming, while Bluetooth 5.2 ensures fast connectivity for peripherals.

 

• 
 Robust Power Delivery with 18+2 Power Stages 

 
• The motherboard features a high-quality power design with 18+2 power stages, ensuring stable and reliable power delivery to your CPU, even during intense overclocking and heavy workloads.

 

• 
 Comprehensive Cooling System 

 
• Multiple fan headers, robust heatsinks, and an M.2 heatsink provide excellent cooling performance, reducing thermal throttling and maintaining optimal temperatures during high-performance tasks.

 

• 
 Dual M.2 Slots and Four SATA III Ports 

 
• Dual M.2 PCIe Gen 4.0 slots and four SATA III ports allow for flexible and fast storage options, making it easy to store large game libraries, media files, and projects.

 

• 
 High-Quality Audio with Realtek ALC4080 Codec 

 
• The Realtek ALC4080 codec offers 8-channel high-definition audio, ensuring an immersive sound experience for gaming, music, and content creation.

 

• 
 Aura Sync RGB Lighting 

 
• Customizable RGB lighting lets you personalize the motherboard’s aesthetic to match your system’s theme, with support for Aura Sync-compatible components.
